title: Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting
abstract: arXiv:2611.28321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. tldr: 该论文提出“点击与计数”多模态原型自适应框架，通过冻结分割模型将单次点击扩展为精确目标掩码，并在迭代原型细化中逐步融合文本描述，从而去除了边界框标注需求，实现类无关目标计数。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a multimodal class-agnostic object counting framework that expands a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model and fuses text descriptions at every prototype-refinement step, eliminating the need for hand-drawn bounding boxes.
